question: Will AST publish the practical-driving-test calendar or a candidate convocation for its 73-operator selection by 12 November 2026?

calls.reasoning: Status quo as of 30 Oct: no practical-test calendar; AST said it would draft it only after requirements verification of several hundred candidates. 17-day window (26 Oct-12 Nov), ~41% elapsed with no press reports of a calendar (couldn't load astsicilia.it due to cert error). AST has been fast (pre-selection calendar ~1.5-2 weeks ahead, scores within 3 days) and is under service pressure, but requirements checks plus organising driving commissions in 6 cities typically take 2-4 weeks; several secondary sources cite a ≥15-day notice rule which would put publication for late-Nov tests around mid-Nov. No human market found (Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi/bookmakers: none).

calls.dossier:
- Resolves off astsicilia.it 'Lavora con Noi'/'News' item stating at least one practical driving-test date for the 73 operatori di esercizio selection (partial calendars count; revisions count); fallback selezioniastpalermo.it notice board or credible sources. Requirements-check outcomes or admitted lists without dates do NOT count; revocation/suspension = NO.
- Event window: 26 Oct 2026 (last notice, scores) -> end 12 Nov 2026 Europe/Rome; as of 2026-11-03T02:10Z about 41% elapsed (7 of 17 days).
- Timeline: bando 28 Aug 2026; applications 29 Aug-27 Sep; pre-selection calendar posted ~5-12 Oct (communication of 5 Oct, update 12 Oct) for tests 21-23 Oct; score list published 23-26 Oct (astsicilia.it). Score notice: after requirements check per art. 8, the practical-test calendar will be drafted.
- As of 30 Oct (question background): no practical-test calendar; latest Lavora con Noi item is the 26 Oct scores notice.
- 3 Nov 2026: selezioniastpalermo.it shows 'NESSUNA SELEZIONE PUBBLICA ATTIVA', directs to the main AST site for calendars/results.
- astsicilia.it and aziendasicilianatrasporti.it could not be fetched this run (self-signed certificate error); post-30 Oct state unverified directly.
- Web/news searches (3 Nov) found no press report of an AST practical-test calendar or convocation.
- Several secondary summaries (livesicilia/lentepubblica-type coverage, via search snippets) say the calendar, venue and times will be published at least 15 days before tests begin; the question background says the current bando sets no minimum notice. Some of these summaries cite 20 km/50-point details that differ from the current bando (15 km/40 points), so they may describe the revoked Jan 2026 bando.
- Workload: requirements verification (D licence, CQC persone, experience) for several hundred candidates in the 29-page score list; driving commissions and buses across Palermo, Catania, Messina, Siracusa, Trapani, Modica.
- Comparable: AMAT Palermo posted a driving-test calendar on 27 Oct for tests 3-6 Nov (about 1 week ahead).
- Pressure: late-Oct local press said AST risks cutting services if the new drivers are not hired soon.
- Searched but not found: any AST statement giving a target date for practical tests; any human prediction market (Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi/bookmakers: none).

calls.reasoning: Status quo: as of 30 Oct, nothing on practical-test dates had been posted. AST has to finish the requirements check first, and I could not see the site for 30 Oct–3 Nov. About 10 days remain (3–12 Nov). AST has been fairly quick so far: about 3.5 weeks from applications closing to the pre-selection, and scores out within days. Pressure from threatened service cuts pushes toward a fast calendar. Against that: hundreds of candidates' documents to check, commissions and buses to organise in six cities, the selection's history of political interruptions (a regional stop, a revoked first bando), and the chance AST first posts an admitted/excluded list, which doesn't count. Reference class: Sicilian public bus-operator selections. The gap from pre-selection scores (or the admitted list) to the practical-test calendar is usually 2–6 weeks. Here the window ends 17 days after scores. No human market found on Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi or bookmakers.
calls.dossier:
- Resolution instrument: resolves off astsicilia.it 'Lavora con Noi' / News items that state at least one practical driving-test date. A partial calendar or a revision also counts. Requirements-check outcomes and admitted/excluded lists do NOT count. Fallback sources: selezioniastpalermo.it or credible press.
- Event window: from now up to the end of 12 Nov 2026 (Europe/Rome). The effective window opened when scores were published on 26 Oct, so 26 Oct -> 12 Nov is about 17 days. As of 3 Nov 02:10 UTC roughly 8 of those days (~47%) have passed, with 10 days left.
- AST scores notice (26 Oct 2026, per question background): after the requirements check under art. 8 of the bando, AST will draw up the practical-test calendar. No timeline is given.
- selezioniastpalermo.it (checked 3 Nov 2026): shows 'NESSUNA SELEZIONE PUBBLICA ATTIVA' and sends visitors to the main AST site for the exam calendar and results. No practical-test info there.
- astsicilia.it could not be fetched this run (self-signed certificate error), so its status for 30 Oct–3 Nov is unverified.
- Notice periods: search snippets from coverage of the first, revoked bando (Jan 2026) mention a calendar 'almeno 15 giorni prima' and a 50-point test. The question background says the new bando sets no minimum notice and a 40-point test. Either way, a notice period limits when tests can be held, not when the calendar is posted.
- AST's pace so far: applications closed 27 Sep; the pre-selection calendar was posted around 5–10 Oct (snippets mention 'comunicazione n. 20 del 5 ottobre'); tests ran 21–23 Oct; scores came out 23–26 Oct.
- Comparables: AMAT Palermo (50 operators) posted a driving-test calendar on 4 Aug 2026 for 806 candidates, with tests from 31 Aug to 4 Dec (La Sicilia). It also posted a calendar on 27 Oct for tests on 3–6 Nov (question background).
- History: the first AST bando (Jan 2026) was halted by the Regional Government after union protests and then revoked. The new bando was issued 28 Aug 2026 (Gazzetta del Sud, 2 Sep 2026).
- Pressure: 49 new buses are coming into service, and late-Oct local press reports AST risks cutting services without the new drivers.
- Work still to do: verify the requirements of the candidates who qualified (the score PDF is 29 pages long), then set up commissions and dual-control buses across six cities.
- Searched but not found: any press report of practical-test dates; any appeal or freeze after the pre-selection; how many candidates are admitted to the practical test; any Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi or bookmaker market.

calls.reasoning: As of 30 Oct, no practical-test calendar has been posted. AST's 26 Oct notice says the calendar comes after a requirements check of about 300 qualifiers, and no timeline is given. About 9.9 of the 17 window days remain. AST has moved fast before: the pre-selection calendar came 8 days after applications closed, and scores came within days. Service-cut pressure also argues for speed. Against that: requirements verification, setting up commissions and buses in six cities, the risk of an admitted-list-only notice that does not count, and the selection's history of political interruption. Comparable Sicilian operators posted calendars about 1-2 weeks before tests. If AST targets tests in late November, publication could fall either side of 12 Nov. Overall slightly below even.
calls.reconciliation: The runs agree on the factual state: no calendar as of 30 Oct, astsicilia.it unreachable on 3 Nov because of a certificate error, no press reports, no human market on Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi or bookmakers. One factual point is open: whether a 15-day minimum notice applies. Run snippets attribute it to the revoked January bando, and the question background says the current bando sets none. I could not settle this without web access. Either way it constrains when tests are held, not when the calendar is posted, so it barely matters. The rest is judgment about how fast AST will verify requirements and organise logistics. AST's demonstrated speed and the service pressure are offset by the workload and the admitted-list-first risk. I land at 0.40, the reading I would bet on.
